V2831.summary: Maffeo da Treviglio to Ludovico Sforza: King Matthias will not go to the Diet without letters from the Emperor that let him come away justified; the new Neapolitan ambassador is to reconcile the Queen with the King and has raised again the match of John Corvinus with don Federico's daughter, which the King takes as made in spite of the Milanese marriage; courtiers tell messer Francesco he goes to Naples 'to undo what you have cooked'; Maffeo advises that the Queen will spare no effort to turn the King and will not yield 'to the insatiable wrath of Juno'.
V2831.en:
Page 1. Your Excellency understands at what point the peace negotiation stands, and consequently this Diet. This
Most Serene King of Hungary is jealous of his honour, as I have written at other times; there is no doubt that […]
desires peace, but not so much that he will accept a […] […] of his […]. He will not […] nor […] expressly to go to the
Diet, since even in the Emperor he does not see a [?foundation] for peace, so that it could not be imputed to him that
the negotiation was broken off by him. It also seems hard to him to go there to obtain nothing and receive scorn; and
so he wants letters from the Emperor which […] him to go, affirming that he is well disposed to peace, and with this he
is [?content] to go, even if he were sure that no conclusion would come of it, because it seems to him […] he can always
justify himself and satisfy his honour.

R1098.summary: Maffeo to Ludovico Sforza: the King left on the 8th for Vienna, less drawn by hope of the Diet than by his own wish to go; the legate, the other ambassadors and Maffeo have decided to leave on the 15th.
R1098.en:
Rests on: the 18 Sept 2026 reading (r1098reading.md, lines 1-4 and 7-8 unchanged) and a re-read on 23 Oct 2026 of
lines 5-10 from native crops of IMGR1098I5648P1 with the original key "Cum Mapheo Triviliensi" (ASMi Sforzesco
cart. 1597 no. 111, DECODE R5411, keyR5411.md), found by the b25 re-read and not available on 18 Sept. Sign
corrections: trans/r1098p1v3corrections.tsv. The clear p. 2 of the same letter says independently that the legate,
the other ambassadors and Maffeo decided to leave on the 15th by the road to Vienna (ll. 7-10 repeat it). New values
used, all from R5411: n with a long crossbar = tt ("tutti"), ɒ = l ("lochi"), ƀ = fa ("facto"), 7 =
f ("edificare"), ʒ = r and δ = s ("presto"), n# = ss ("andassimo", "spassando"), ꝛ = e ("fece"). Holes: [?word]
partly carried, [word] supplied, [...] unread signs.

V267.summary: Calibration pair: the cipher letter of 2 Apr 1490 with its contemporary clear extract (Vestigia 268): the Turkish ambassador is still at court and treats, among other things, of a prolongation of the peace.
V267.en:
The Turk's ambassador is still here; this Most Serene Lord King has heard him only once. The prelates and some
barons have been with him many times since, and as far as I can understand, among other things he is also treating
with him of a prolongation of the peace. What more I can learn I shall report to Your Lordship, who I wish to be
certain that I shall not fail to investigate. I commend myself to Your Excellency. Vienna, 2 April 1490.
